accountability_statement: AI assists. QGIS verifies. People decide.

ACT02.classification_note: Low, Medium, and High are training-only exercise bands.
ACT02.verification_method: Use the QGIS expression preview, temporarily substitute each literal for population_2024, read the preview result, and do not save the literal tests. Run the final expression on an editable working copy of the ACT01 profile and keep the raw CSV unchanged.

ACT05.method: Polygon bounding-box intersection for the supplied rectangular synthetic layers
ACT05.limitation: Intersection shows mapped exposure only. It does not establish damage, risk, urgency, travel time, or an operational priority.
